title: Witness (vector representation)
description: A witness in the JSON representation used by test vectors and cross-language fixtures. This is NOT a serialization of live private material: witness values in this form belong in checked-in vector files with no real secrecy, and real prover input is written by the crucible-witness encoder as Prover.toml. The 'private' map and 'public' bag must never share a name.

private.description: Private witness values keyed by name. Values are canonical lowercase hex.
